200.description:
Read one sitter's public profile by profile `slug` or profile `url` (`GET /api/v7/people/full-sitter-profile/?slug=`, endpoint ep-full-profile). Returns identity (opk, slug, short name), profile texts, ratings and review counts, responsiveness, member-since date, badges, home attributes, and every active service with its listed rates: for each add-on rate (standard, holiday, additional dog, puppy, cat care, ...) both `price` (the sitter's listed rate) and `full_price` (that rate plus Rover's owner-side service fee as Rover displays it), the unit (night, visit, walk, day), which dog sizes and cats the service accepts, spaces, whether new customers are accepted, and the cancellation policy. Rates are advertised prices, not quotes: holiday adjustments and taxes are not included. Unknown slug is `not_found`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

200.description:
Read a sitter's public availability calendar for one service over a date window (`GET /api/v7/people/{opk}/public-calendar/`, endpoint ep-calendar). Input `opk` from a search result or `get_sitter`, the service slug, and `start_date`/`end_date` (default: today through six weeks ahead, at most 120 days). Returns the sitter's calendar preferences (spaces, days of week, away flag) and one entry per day with `spaces_available`/`spaces_occupied` per calendar, plus `updated_at` (when the sitter last updated the calendar) and a count of days with at least one space. This is sitter-listed availability, not a booking guarantee. Unknown opk is `not_found`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

Tianci and Ran are incredible! We are devastated they no longer do doggy daycare but we would 100% recommend them for boarding. They took such good care of our little girl and it is unlikely you will ever get such amazing picture updates from anyone else.

Tianci and Ran were the best sitters for our Theo while we were on vacation for the week! They updated their Google Photos shared album with us daily which we absolutely loved. We could tell Theo was being very well taken care of and they took him on so many adventures which was fun to see too! Will definitely book them again for the next time we’re out of town!
Tianci took great care of our dog while we were out of town. We felt comfortable the entire time, and we could tell that he was enjoying himself. We appreciated all the photo updates.

Tianci was wonderful! I was immediately at ease during our meet and greet as she showed us the building and explained her routine with the dogs under her care. During Baloo's 4 day stay we got so many wonderful pictures uploaded to an album. Baloo seemed very well cared for and doted on the entire time. Drop-off and pick up was a breeze, as was communication. If you're looking for a warm, reliable sitter, Tianci is her!

Our malty-poo, Winston had such a great time with Tianci and Ran. They were so loving to him and took him on many walking adventures around the city. We also loved all the photo updates while we were traveling.

Tianci and her husband Ran were great with Zoey! Zoey got so much love and attention from them on her days she spent at their place. She was a very spoiled pup frequently getting new treats and toys to play with. I also love how the way they do the photo updates with Google! Very bummed they are no longer able to do doggy day care but we plan to use them for boarding in the future.

Excellent!!!! This was my first time with Tianci and her husband. They did such an incredible job taking care of my 12 year old dog.  Just truly kind and enthusiastic people. Tons of pictures, I can tell my dog had a great time with them and they with her as well. She was using a cone after a minor procedure and did a great job with after care etc. Very flexible and accommodating as well when my flight was delayed. I would definitely recommend them and most definitely use their services again.

Tianci was the most amazing sitter for my dog Harold! She was so communicative and I could tell she loves dogs and making sure they’re well taken care of. Harold had the best time staying with her and didn’t want to leave! Tianci shared photo updates and messages throughout Harold’s stay and I loved seeing how happy he was in the pictures! I will surely be booking Tianci again in the future, and I highly recommend her for anyone wanting to make sure their dog is well-loved while they’re away!

Tianci and ran took such amazing care of Suga and kept us updated with thoughtful messages and photos, which gave us so much peace of mind. Suga looked so happy and comfortable the entire stay. We could really tell how much care and attention they gave him. We’re so grateful and would absolutely book with her again. Highly recommend!

200.description:
Search Rover sitters for one service around a location (`GET /api/v7/search-optimized/`, endpoint ep-search-api). Filters: `service_type` (overnight-boarding = boarding in the sitter's home, overnight-traveling = house sitting in the owner's home, drop-in = drop-in visits, dog-walking, doggy-day-care), `location` as a free-text place (use the exact `description` from `suggest_locations`, e.g. `Seattle, WA, USA`), `pet_type` dog or cat, optional `start_date`/`end_date`, dog-size flags, `min_price`/`max_price` and `page` (20 results per page; `next_page` and the continuation give the next one). Each result is a sitter card: opk and slug (the identifiers `get_sitter`, `get_sitter_availability` and `list_sitter_reviews` take), name, headline, listed price per unit in the market currency, rating and review counts, neighbourhood and distance from the search centre, badges, and `available_for_selected_dates` exactly as Rover reports it (`unknown` is a real value: search results never confirm availability; use `get_sitter_availability`). The response `location` block says what Rover geocoded the input to. A location Rover cannot geocode makes it fall back to the request IP's area; this program refuses that with `invalid_input` instead of returning unrelated sitters. Market follows the proxy exit (US, USD); a non-US location therefore also fails as not resolvable.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `api_url` | string |  |
| `available_for_selected_dates` | string | Rover's own value (`unknown`, `available`, ...); never a confirmation. |
| `badges` | object[] |  |
| `browsable_services` | string[] |  |
| `calendar_updated_days_ago` | number |  |
| `cancellation_policy` | string |  |
| `image_url` | string |  |
| `location` | object |  |
| `opk` | string | Sitter id (personOpk) for `get_sitter_availability` and `list_sitter_reviews`. |
| `price` | object |  |
| `profile_status` | string | Profile status badge slug such as star-sitter, when Rover shows one. |
| `profile_url` | string |  |
| `rank` | number |  |
| `rating_average` | number |  |
| `repeat_client_count` | number |  |
| `reviews_count` | number |  |
| `service_type` | string |  |
| `short_name` | string |  |
| `slug` | string | Profile slug (from the profile URL) for `get_sitter`. |
| `title` | string | Sitter's profile headline. |
| `years_of_experience` | string |  |
